University Grants Commission Apex Academic Portal (ugc.gov.in)

paper_1.stage_name: Paper 1: General Paper on Teaching & Research Aptitude (Common to All Candidates)
units: Teaching Aptitude: Concept, Objectives, Levels of Teaching (Memory, Understanding, Reflective), Learner Characteristics, Teaching Support Systems (Traditional, Modern, ICT-based), Evaluation Systems (CBCS, Computer-based testing)

Research Aptitude: Research Meaning, Types & Characteristics, Positivism & Post-positivistic approach to research, Methods of Research (Experimental, Descriptive, Historical, Qualitative, Quantitative), Steps of Research, Thesis & Article writing, Plagiarism & Research Ethics
Comprehension: A passage of text with analytical questions

Communication: Meaning, Types & Characteristics of Communication, Effective Communication (Verbal, Non-verbal, Intercultural, Group, Classroom), Barriers to Effective Communication, Mass-Media & Society

Mathematical Reasoning & Aptitude: Types of reasoning, Number series, Letter series, Codes & Relationships, Fractions, Time & Distance, Ratio, Proportion, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Interest & Discounting

Logical Reasoning: Understanding structure of arguments, Forms of argument, Categorical propositions, Mood & Figure, Formal & Informal fallacies, Square of Opposition, Deductive & Inductive reasoning, Venn diagrams, Indian Logic (Pramanas: Pratyaksha, Anumana, Upamana, Shabda, Arthapatti, Anupalabdhi), Structure of Anumana, Vyapti, Hetvabhasa

Data Interpretation: Sources, Acquisition & Classification of Data, Quantitative & Qualitative Data, Graphical Representation (Bar-chart, Histogram, Pie-chart, Table-chart, Line-chart), Data & Governance

Information & Communication Technology (ICT): General abbreviations & Terminology, Basics of Internet, Intranet, E-mail, Audio & Video-conferencing, Digital initiatives in higher education (SWAYAM, SWAYAM PRABHA, DigiLocker, Shodhganga), ICT & Governance

People, Development & Environment: Development & Environment, Millennium Development Goals (MDGs), Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 1-17), Human & Environmental interaction, Anthropogenic activities, Environmental issues (Air, Water, Soil, Noise, Hazardous waste, Climate change), Health impacts, Natural & Energy resources (Solar, Wind, Hydro, Geothermal, Biomass, Nuclear), Natural hazards & Disasters, Environmental Protection Act 1986, National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), International agreements (Montreal Protocol, Rio Summit, CBD, Kyoto Protocol, Paris Agreement, ISA)

Higher Education System: Institutions of higher learning & Education in ancient India (Takshashila, Nalanda, Valabhi, Vikramashila), Evolution of higher learning in post-independence India, Oriental, Conventional & Non-conventional learning programmes, Professional, Technical & Skill-based education, Value education & Environmental education, Policies, Governance & Administration (UGC, AICTE, NAAC, NIRF, NEP 2020)

paper_2.scope: Comprehensive domain-specific testing based on the master's level curriculum chosen by candidate.

subjects.name: Teaching Aptitude, Research Methodology & Communication (शिक्षण अभिवृत्ति, शोध प्रविधि एवं संप्रेषण)
domains: Teaching Aptitude: Levels of Teaching (Memory - Herbart, Understanding - Morrison, Reflective - Hunt)
Learner Characteristics: Adolescent & Adult learners (Academic, Social, Emotional, Cognitive)
Teaching Methods: Teacher-centered vs Learner-centered, Offline vs Online methods (SWAYAM, SWAYAM PRABHA, MOOCs)
Teaching Support System: Traditional, Modern and ICT based pedagogies
Evaluation Systems: Elements of evaluation, Choice Based Credit System (CBCS), Computer-based testing, Innovations
Research Aptitude: Meaning, Characteristics & Types of research (Fundamental, Applied, Action, Exploratory, Explanatory)
Approaches to Research: Positivism vs Post-positivistic approach to research
Methods of Research: Experimental (Variables: IV, DV, Extraneous), Descriptive, Historical, Qualitative vs Quantitative
Steps of Research & Design: Problem formulation, Hypothesis testing (Type I & Type II errors), Sampling techniques
Thesis and Article Writing: Format, Citation styles (APA, MLA, Chicago), Reference management
Application of ICT in Research: Data analysis software (SPSS, R, Python, NVivo), Plagiarism detection tools (Turnitin, Urkund)
Research Ethics: Integrity, Fabrication, Falsification, UGC Guidelines on Academic Integrity and Prevention of Plagiarism
Communication: Meaning, types and characteristics of communication
Effective Communication: Verbal and Non-verbal, Intercultural and Group communication, Classroom communication dynamics
Barriers to Effective Communication: Psychological, Semantic, Organizational, Cultural barriers
Mass-Media and Society: Role in public opinion, Digital broadcasting, Social media impact

subjects.name: Mathematical Reasoning, Logical Reasoning & Data Interpretation (गणितीय तर्क, युक्ति-युक्त तर्क, भारतीय तर्कशास्त्र एवं आंकड़ा निर्वचन)
domains: Mathematical Reasoning: Number series, Alphabet series, Coding and Decoding, Blood relations, Direction sense
Mathematical Aptitude: Fractions, Time & Distance, Ratio, Proportion, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Simple & Compound Interest, Averages
Logical Reasoning: Structure of arguments, Premises and Conclusions, Deductive vs Inductive reasoning
Categorical Propositions: Quantity and Quality, Distribution of terms, Mood and Figure of Syllogisms
Classical Square of Opposition: Contradictory, Contrary, Subcontrary, Subalternation relations
Formal and Informal Fallacies: Fallacy of undistributed middle, Ad hominem, Straw man, Slippery slope, Petitio principii
Venn Diagrams: Analytical representation of categorical syllogisms and valid argument testing
Indian Logic (भारतीय तर्कशास्त्र): Means of Knowledge (Pramanas - प्रमाण)
Pramanas: Pratyaksha (Perception), Anumana (Inference), Upamana (Comparison), Shabda (Verbal Testimony), Arthapatti (Postulation), Anupalabdhi (Non-apprehension)
Structure and Kinds of Anumana: Paksha, Sadhya, Hetu, Pararthanumana, Svarthanumana, Purvavat, Sheshavat, Samanyatodrishta
Vyapti & Hetvabhasa: Invariable concomitance (Vyapti) and Fallacies of Inference (Hetvabhasa: Savyabhichara, Viruddha, Satpratipaksha, Asiddha, Badhita)
Data Interpretation: Sources, acquisition and classification of data
Quantitative and Qualitative Data Representation: Tabulation, Bar charts, Histograms, Pie charts, Line graphs
Data Analysis & Data Governance: Percentage calculation, Ratio analysis, Trend evaluation, Data driven decision making

subjects.name: ICT, People, Development & Environment and Higher Education System (सूचना एवं संचार प्रौद्योगिकी, लोक, विकास व पर्यावरण एवं उच्च शिक्षा प्रणाली)
subjects.short_name: UGC NET ICT Env & Higher Ed
domains: ICT Fundamentals: General abbreviations and terminology (ASCII, Unicode, RAM, ROM, Cloud, Cache)
Networking & Internet: IP address, IPv4 vs IPv6, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, Intranet, Search engines, Web 2.0 and Web 3.0
Digital Initiatives in Higher Education: NPTEL, SWAYAM, SWAYAM PRABHA (40 DTH channels), National Digital Library (NDL), DigiLocker, Shodhganga, e-ShodhSindhu, NAD
Cybersecurity & ICT Governance: Phishing, Ransomware, Firewall, Digital India, e-Governance models
People, Development and Environment: Millennium Development Goals (MDGs - 8 goals) and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 1-17, 2030 Agenda)
Human and Environment Interaction: Anthropogenic impacts, Deforestation, Urbanization, Carbon footprint
Environmental Pollution: Air pollution (PM2.5, PM10, smog, AQI), Water pollution (BOD, COD, heavy metals), Soil and Noise pollution (decibel thresholds)
Climate Change & Global Warming: Greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O, CFCs), Global warming potential, Sea level rise, Extreme weather events
Natural Energy Resources: Solar energy (International Solar Alliance - ISA), Wind, Hydro, Geothermal, Biomass, Nuclear energy
Natural Hazards and Disasters: Mitigation strategies, NDMA framework, Early warning systems
Environmental Protection Statutory Frameworks: Environment (Protection) Act 1986, Air Act 1981, Water Act 1974, Wildlife Protection Act 1972
National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC): 8 National Missions (Solar, Energy Efficiency, Sustainable Habitat, Water, Himalayan Eco, Green India, Agriculture, Strategic Knowledge)
International Treaties: Montreal Protocol 1987 (Ozone), Rio Earth Summit 1992, Kyoto Protocol 1997, Paris Agreement 2015, Kigali Amendment 2016
Higher Education in Ancient India: Takshashila, Nalanda, Valabhi, Vikramashila, Odantapuri, Jagaddala; Gurukula and Vihara traditions

Evolution of Modern Higher Education in India: Charter Act 1813, Macaulay's Minute 1835, Wood's Despatch 1854, Universities Act 1904, Wardha Scheme 1937, Radhakrishnan Commission 1948, Mudaliar Commission 1952, Kothari Commission 1964-66, NPE 1968, 1986

National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020): Higher Education Commission of India (HECI) 4 verticals (NHERC, NAC, HEGC, GEC), Academic Bank of Credits (ABC), Multiple Entry and Exit System (MEES), MERUs
Apex Regulatory Bodies: University Grants Commission (UGC Act 1956), AICTE, NCTE, ICSSR, CSIR, NAAC (Grading framework), NIRF rankings

subjects.name: Humanities, Social Sciences, Commerce & Governance Core Perspectives (मानविकी, समाजशास्त्र, अर्थशास्त्र, वाणिज्य एवं लोक प्रशासन परिप्रेक्ष्य)
domains: Indian Constitution & Polity: Preamble, Fundamental Rights (Articles 12-35), Directive Principles of State Policy (Articles 36-51), Fundamental Duties
Union & State Executive and Legislature: President, Prime Minister, Parliament (Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha), Supreme Court & Judicial Review
Public Administration & Governance: Good Governance, Citizen's Charter, Right to Information (RTI Act 2005), Lokpal and Lokayukta
Macroeconomic Foundations: GDP, GNP, Inflation (CPI, WPI), Fiscal Policy vs Monetary Policy (RBI Monetary Policy Committee), NITI Aayog
Banking & Financial Systems: Commercial banks, Scheduled banks, Basel Accords, Capital markets, SEBI regulations, GST structure
International Trade & Globalization: Balance of Payments (BoP), Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), World Trade Organization (WTO), IMF, World Bank
Sociological Perspectives: Classical sociological theorists (Emile Durkheim, Max Weber, Karl Marx), Functionalism, Conflict theory, Symbolic interactionism
Social Stratification & Change in India: Caste system, Class dynamics, Gender relations, Sanskritization (M.N. Srinivas), Social mobility, Urbanization
Political Philosophy & Modern Thinkers: Social Contract theorists (Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau), John Rawls' Theory of Justice, Karl Marx's Historical Materialism
Modern Indian Political Thought: Mahatma Gandhi (Satyagraha, Swaraj, Trusteeship), B.R. Ambedkar (Constitutionalism, Annihilation of Caste), Rabindranath Tagore, Swami Vivekananda, Sri Aurobindo
Philosophical Traditions: Orthodox schools (Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Samkhya, Yoga, Mimamsa, Vedanta) and Heterodox schools (Buddhism, Jainism, Charvaka)
